title: Five Universal Lessons for Writing Poetry and Living Life #clmooc #edu307
summary: Observe your world. Write, live it. Embody meaning. Write and live through your senses. Embrace emotion. Channel joy through pain in word and life. Listen to sounds words paint across the sky. Practice. Then Practice.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
• Observe your world. Write, live it.
  • Embody meaning. Write and live through your senses.
  • Embrace emotion. Channel joy through pain in word and life.
  • Listen to sounds words paint across the sky.
  • Practice. Then Practice.
